risk_analysis.risk_summary: The primary risk involves the calculation of TKDN for laptops using imported high-value components. While the unit value is manageable, cross-border activities and third-party involvement increase the scrutiny on import quotas and AML reporting requirements under FATF standards.
violations_detected: Potensi pelanggaran ambang batas minimum TKDN jika komponen Snapdragon tidak diimbangi riset lokal — source: https://peraturan.go.id/id/permenperin-no-22-tahun-2020
override_log: Finding level HIGH detected — risk level upgraded from MEDIUM to HIGH.

findings.finding: Sertifikasi TKDN perlu diperbarui sesuai tata cara terbaru tahun 2025.
Verifikasi dokumen impor untuk komponen Snapdragon guna memastikan kesesuaian dengan kuota impor terbaru.

recommendations.action: Melakukan audit internal terhadap komposisi biaya produksi untuk memenuhi target TKDN laptop.
Memastikan pelaporan Laporan Surveyor (LS) untuk setiap batch komponen Snapdragon yang diimpor.

compliance_report.executive_summary: ADVAN's laptop manufacturing activities are generally compliant but face increasing regulatory pressure regarding Domestic Component Levels (TKDN) and import restrictions. The recent Permenperin 35/2025 introduces new certification procedures that must be adopted immediately. Management should prioritize local R&D to offset the high value of imported Snapdragon components and maintain a 'Compliant' status for government procurement eligibility.

regulation_monitor.monitor_notes: Recent updates focus on the simplification of TKDN certification (Permenperin 35/2025) and resolution of import bottlenecks for electronic components as discussed in the Kemenkeu Debottlenecking session in March 2026. Companies must ensure compliance with the new ITE law amendments regarding electronic systems.

enforcement.message:
Process ON HOLD. Manual review required before proceeding.

Risk Score: 35/100  |  Risk Level: HIGH  |  Action: REVIEW_REQUIRED

This process is ON HOLD pending manual review by the Compliance team. High-risk findings have been detected that require direct sign-off before the process may continue. All identified violations must be reviewed and a mitigation plan submitted within the deadlines stated in the recommendations.

Key Findings Driving This Decision:
  [HIGH] Verifikasi dokumen impor untuk komponen Snapdragon guna memastikan kesesuaian dengan kuota impor terbaru. (Permendag No. 8 Tahun 2024)

Regulatory Changes Detected (5):
  • Peraturan Menteri Perindustrian Nomor 22 Tahun 2020 tentang Penghitungan TKDN Produk Elektronika — source: https://peraturan.go.id/id/permenperin-no-22-tahun-2020
  • Peraturan Menteri Perdagangan Nomor 8 Tahun 2024 tentang Kebijakan dan Pengaturan Impor — source: https://www.kemenkeu.go.id
  • Peraturan Menteri Perindustrian Nomor 35 Tahun 2025 tentang Ketentuan dan Tata Cara Sertifikasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri — source: https://peraturan.go.id/id/permenperin-no-35-tahun-2025

Active Risk Factors:
  • Ketergantungan tinggi pada komponen impor (Snapdragon) yang memerlukan Persetujuan Impor (PI)
  • Kewajiban pelaporan transaksi lintas negara jika nilai akumulasi melebihi ambang batas PPATK
  • Kepatuhan terhadap standar teknis perangkat telekomunikasi (Sertifikasi SDPPI)

Immediate Actions Required:
  1. [30 days] Melakukan audit internal terhadap komposisi biaya produksi untuk memenuhi target TKDN laptop. — Production & Legal Dept
  2. [immediate] Memastikan pelaporan Laporan Surveyor (LS) untuk setiap batch komponen Snapdragon yang diimpor. — Procurement Dept
